proposals.evidence: Full akasa gives Prakrit aga and explicitly Bshk aga cloud/rain, Tor agha and Phal agha. It states that general retention of k as g in Dardic is obscure. The selected northern sky/cloud forms, including source x for a velar fricative, support this family; the historical consonant development and cross-IA transmission remain qualified. Exact response: āxo.
